expected_value_creation: Organizations can distinguish declared activation from observed execution, prove or reject recovery completion, and promote a trust policy only from reconciled evidence and accountable authority.
supporting_evidence: v0.8.7 makes authority, observation, and rollback plans explicit but deliberately stops short of execution truth and promotion.
Current production guidance requires mode promotion criteria, deployment outcome records, and evidence that rollback restored the expected state.
success_criteria: Every execution reconciliation binds one activation or rollback record to observed provider-neutral execution evidence and expected-versus-observed state.
Every promotion decision requires complete observation, successful reconciliation, accountable authority, and immutable predecessor history.
Mismatch, absent evidence, failed recovery, or unresolved governance deterministically blocks promotion.
